title_zh: 商定资助范围内的园艺试办与征求意见

scenario.label_zh: 确定社区园艺资助试办
scenario.goal_zh: 核对资助可用于工具和两次活动，约定先征求居民意见再排定试办安排

context_zh: 社区花园组织者阅读已批准的小额资助通知。
author: author-phase08-a

sentences.speaker: Helen
sentences.text: The grant is approved, but it only covers shared tools and two weekend sessions.

sentences.speaker: Kwame
sentences.text: That's enough to start the initiative. We don't need to promise a year of classes.

sentences.speaker: Helen
sentences.text: Agreed. The new tools will greatly reduce what volunteers have to bring from home.

sentences.speaker: Kwame
sentences.text: Have the residents had any input into the dates?

sentences.speaker: Helen
sentences.text: Not yet. We suggested Saturdays, but some people work then.

sentences.speaker: Kwame
sentences.text: I'll ask which weekend times they can manage and bring the answers to our next meeting.

sentences.speaker: Helen
sentences.text: Then we'll choose the two sessions and keep the spending within the approved categories.

targets.sense_zh: 旨在改善某事的新举措
